STEP 1 - Scene: A plated main course, likely a dinner: roasted chicken pieces (thigh/leg portion at top left and a breast-like piece at bottom), lentils, roasted yellow squash/zucchini slices, and roasted potatoes with a sage leaf. Photographed from above, roughly top-down, with the square white plate filling most of the frame.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Square white plate, about 26 cm across (dinner plate size). Area ≈ 3.14 × (13)² ≈ 530 cm² for a round equivalent; the square plate's usable area is similar, so use ~530 cm².

- Yellow squash/zucchini slices (center right, plus two slices near chicken)
